title: Nonlinear Exchange Dynamics for Independent Sets
summary: In recent years, nonlinear dynamics derived from kinetic theory have gained attention in the context of sampling configurations of spin systems such as the Ising model. We focus on nonlinear dynamics for the hard-core model, a canonical spin system with hard constraints that specifies a distribution over independent sets in a graph, weighted by their sizes.
